reviews.comment: Dr. Snodgrass is a very kind and caring professor. He was quite lenient with us because it was his first semester teaching, so beware of taking him since he may not be as nice next time. He warned us that he would be tougher the next semester he teaches. However, my experience in his class was pretty good!

He was very clear and straight forward on expectations. He told you what you needed to know and he made sure to tell us how stuff related to industry (occasionally got sidetracked talking about this stuff). But he was straight forward and his tests were made to measure whether we learned the topic not to see if we know some nasty trick in a circuit

Amazing man, can't say enough good things about him in this little post. First year prof but he got better with communicating the material as the sem went on. Only thing that mattered to him was his students success so he was constantly pushing back assignments to make sure we didn't get overloaded and tested us on the basics on the exams. BESTPROF

First year professor so lectures could be iffy and unclear at times but you can't not LOVE this man. He's amazing, passionate, and clearly wants his students to succeed. Haters may come and say he was a bad prof, but thats only because this was his first year teaching and he got exponentially better as the sem went on.

I truly haven't had another professor that goes above and beyond to help students succeed like Dr. Snodgrass. First year prof, but really took everything in stride. Very helpful in office hours, clear on expectations, responds to questions quickly, encourages discussion in class, cares for students. Can't say it enough, take him for 214 if you can.

It was his first semester teaching, but Snoddy is the best. Absolutely the best ECEN professor I have had so far. he's an extremely caring and considerate man, that always makes time for his student's questions. He's clearly passionate about teaching, truly cares about your success in his class, and offers plenty of partial credit to help. The GOAT

This was Snodgrass' first semester teaching, so things were a little rocky to start off with, but the further we got into the semester the better he got. He's a very caring professor, and communicates clearly with the class, responding to questions sometimes in under 5 minutes, and really cares about students learning the material.

First semester being a prof, so he offered a TON of extra credit. Exams were over the bare minimum, so they were quite easy if you studied. Some hw problems were ridiculously hard, but hw wasn't worth much anyways. Lectures were a little lackluster at times, but I imagine in the future he will be a very good lecturer and one of tamu's best profs.
